kp_system.name: Krishnamurti Paddhati
kp_system.description: A refined system of Vedic astrology that emphasizes the sub-lord as the decisive factor in chart interpretation. KP introduces mathematical precision to horary astrology and birth chart analysis through the subdivision of nakshatras into sub-divisions based on Vimshottari Dasha proportions.
key_principles: Nakshatra subdivision creates 249 precise divisions in zodiac
Event timing depends on dasha activation of significators
Retrograde planets give results of previously occupied houses

1.significance: Represents native's physical form, constitution, and overall vitality

2.significance: Indicates financial status, family relationships, and capacity for speech

3.significance: Represents mental abilities, communication skills, and short journeys

4.significance: Signifies domestic happiness, maternal influence, and real estate matters

5.significance: Indicates creative potential, progeny, and intellectual capabilities

6.significance: Represents challenges, health issues, and service-related matters

7.significance: Signifies marital relationships, business partnerships, and public interactions

8.significance: Represents hidden forces, occult knowledge, and transformative events

9.significance: Indicates fortune, spiritual guidance, and higher knowledge

10.significance: Represents professional achievement, social status, and public image

11.significance: Signifies achievement of desires, friendships, and material prosperity

12.significance: Represents spiritual liberation, losses, and matters of isolation

marriage.description: 2nd = family addition and expansion, 7th = spouse and partnership bond, 11th = fulfillment of marriage desire. 6th = separation and conflict, 10th = partner away from home, 12th = loss of marital relationship.

career.description: 2nd = income and earnings, 6th = service and employment competition, 10th = profession and authority, 11th = gains from job. 5th/9th = away from regular service or study, 12th = loss of status or position.

children.description: 2nd = family growth and expansion, 5th = progeny and childbirth, 11th = fulfillment of desire for children. 4th = away from children, 10th = children away from home.

wealth.description: 2nd = bank balance and accumulated wealth, 6th = overcoming debt, 10th = earning capacity through profession, 11th = receipt of money and gains. 8th = hidden losses and inheritance issues, 12th = expenditure and financial outflow.

health.description: 1st = physical body and immunity, 5th/9th = trinal protection for good health, 11th = recovery and positive health outcomes. 6th = disease and illness, 8th = chronic conditions, 12th = hospitalization and health emergency.

education.description: 4th = basic and foundational education, 9th = higher learning and advanced studies, 11th = success and completion of education. 3rd = distraction, 8th = interruption, 12th = change of institution or studies abroad.

travel_short.description: 3rd = short local journeys and travels, 9th = extended travel distance, 12th = going away or relocation. 4th = staying rooted at home.

travel_foreign.description: 3rd = initial travel impulse, 9th = foreign travel and international journeys, 12th = settlement abroad and permanent relocation. 4th = rooted at home, unable to travel.

property.description: 4th = immovable property and real estate ownership, 11th = acquiring and gaining property, 12th = investment in property. 3rd/10th = negotiations and dealings in property.

legal.description: 6th = winning over opposition and legal victory, 11th = favorable verdict and successful outcome. 7th = opponent's strength and equal opposition, 12th = loss of legal case.

spiritual.description: 5th = mantra siddhi and spiritual practices, 9th = guru connection and dharma, 12th = moksha and spiritual liberation. 1st/10th = worldly attachment and material focus.

level_1.name: Planets in the star of occupants
level_1.description: Most powerful significators. Planets whose nakshatra lord occupies the queried house are strongest indicators.
level_1.example: If Mars occupies 5th house and Venus is in Mars's nakshatra, Venus becomes a strong 5th house significator

level_2.name: Occupants of the house
level_2.description: Planets physically placed in the house are significant for that house's matters.
level_2.example: Jupiter in 5th house directly indicates children and progeny

level_3.name: Planets in the star of the house lord
level_3.description: Planets whose nakshatra lord is the owner of the house sign are moderately significant.
level_3.example: If Sun owns 5th house and Mercury is in Sun's nakshatra, Mercury significates 5th house

level_4.name: House lord
level_4.description: The planet that owns the sign on the cusp of the house is the weakest significator.
level_4.example: Leo on 5th house cusp makes Sun the 5th house lord

ruling_planets.description: Five factors that confirm KP predictions at the moment of judgment or query

factors.name: ascendant_sign_lord
factors.description: Lord of the rising sign at query time

factors.name: ascendant_star_lord
factors.description: Nakshatra lord of the ascendant degree

factors.name: moon_sign_lord
factors.description: Lord of the sign Moon occupies at query time

factors.name: moon_star_lord
factors.description: Nakshatra lord of Moon's degree at query time

factors.name: day_lord
factors.description: Planet ruling the weekday of query

ruling_planets.usage: Planets appearing as ruling planets that also significate the queried house CONFIRM the event. The more a planet repeats across the five factors, the stronger its role in the event. A single repetition indicates possibility, double repetition indicates probability, triple or more indicates certainty.

kp_ayanamsa.name: Krishnamurti Ayanamsa
kp_ayanamsa.description: The ayanamsa (precession correction) used exclusively in the KP system. It differs slightly from the more commonly used Lahiri ayanamsa.
kp_ayanamsa.difference_from_lahiri: approximately 6 arc-minutes less than Lahiri ayanamsa
kp_ayanamsa.year_introduced: Developed by Prof. K.S. Krishnamurti in the 1960s
kp_ayanamsa.precision: Provides greater precision for horary and divisional chart calculations
kp_ayanamsa.note: The 108 system supports KP ayanamsa via the 'krishnamurti' parameter in planetary_positions tool

sub_lord_theory.name: Sub-Lord Theory
sub_lord_theory.description: The core innovation and foundation of Krishnamurti Paddhati. Each nakshatra (13°20') is divided into 9 unequal sub-divisions proportional to the Vimshottari Dasha years of each planet.
sub_lord_theory.division_method: Each of the 27 nakshatras is subdivided into 9 parts following the Vimshottari sequence
sub_lord_theory.subdivision_sequence: Ketu(7yr) → Venus(20yr) → Sun(6yr) → Moon(10yr) → Mars(7yr) → Rahu(18yr) → Jupiter(16yr) → Saturn(19yr) → Mercury(17yr)
sub_lord_theory.total_subdivisions: 27 nakshatras × 9 sub-lords = 243 total sub-divisions across 360° zodiac
sub_lord_theory.significance: The sub-lord of a house cusp is the DECISIVE FACTOR in KP. It determines whether the house promise is fulfilled (sub-lord significates supporting houses) or denied (sub-lord significates denial houses).
sub_lord_theory.cuspal_sub_lord: Most critical: the sub-lord occupying the house cusp is more important than the house lord
sub_lord_theory.principle: An event occurs when: (1) Significators activate via dasha/transit AND (2) Sub-lord of that house's cusp signifies its favorable disposition

sub_lord_favorable.condition: Sub-lord in star of planets significating supporting houses
sub_lord_favorable.practical: If 5th cusp sub-lord is in Jupiter's star (Jupiter significates 5th), children are promised

sub_lord_unfavorable.condition: Sub-lord in star of planets significating denial houses
sub_lord_unfavorable.practical: If 5th cusp sub-lord is in Saturn's star (Saturn significates 6,8,12), children are denied

sub_lord_mixed.condition: Sub-lord connects to both supporting and denial houses
sub_lord_mixed.result: MIXED - Results depend on dasha timing and transit activation
sub_lord_mixed.practical: Event occurs late or with delays/obstacles; timing becomes critical

retrograde_in_kp.description: In KP, retrograde planets are NOT weakened. They give results of the house they PREVIOUSLY occupied (by transit).
retrograde_in_kp.practical: A retrograde significator may delay results but does not deny them if it signifies the right houses. The event manifests through the planet's previous house significations.

conjunction_in_kp.description: In KP, conjunction means planets share the same sub-lord division. This creates a powerful connection between their significations.
conjunction_in_kp.principle: Planets in same sub-lord = synchronized results
conjunction_in_kp.practical: When one conjoined planet is activated by dasha/transit, the other also gives results. Their combined significations must be analyzed.

exaltation_debilitation.description: In KP, exaltation and debilitation are considered but are SECONDARY to sub-lord analysis. The sub-lord is always the deciding factor.
exaltation_debilitation.practical: A debilitated planet with favorable sub-lord can still give results; an exalted planet with unfavorable sub-lord will not.

dasha_activation.name: Dasha Activation of Events
dasha_activation.description: Events manifest when the dasha periods of significators activate
dasha_activation.significance_rule: For an event to occur: (1) Dasha must be of a significator for that matter AND (2) Sub-lord of that house must be favorable
dasha_activation.double_activation: When both Mahadasha and Antardasha lords significate the same house, results are very strong
dasha_activation.example: Marriage in Jupiter Mahadasha, Venus Antardasha if both are 7th house significators and 7th cusp sub-lord is favorable

cusps_and_sub_lords.name: Critical Role of Cusps and Sub-Lords
cusps_and_sub_lords.description: In KP, the cusps of houses are far more important than in traditional Vedic astrology
cusps_and_sub_lords.twelve_cusps: Each of the 12 house cusps has its own sub-lord which determines that house's promise
cusps_and_sub_lords.cusp_subdivision: Houses are not entire signs but precise degree intervals determined by Placidus house system
cusps_and_sub_lords.sub_lord_determination: Find which nakshatra-sub combination the house cusp degree falls into; that sub-lord is the decider
cusps_and_sub_lords.example: If 7th house cusp is at 15°23'30", find which nakshatra-sub this degree belongs to. That sub-lord determines marriage timing and quality.

birth_chart_analysis.name: KP Birth Chart Reading Sequence

step_1.name: Identify House Cusps
step_1.description: Calculate exact degree of each house cusp using Placidus system

step_2.name: Find Cusp Sub-Lords
step_2.description: For each cusp, determine which nakshatra-sub it occupies

step_3.name: Determine Significators
step_3.description: List all significators for each house (level 1-4) in order of strength

step_4.name: Check Sub-Lord Disposition
step_4.description: Does each cusp's sub-lord signify supporting or denial houses?

step_5.name: Analyze Dasha Periods
step_5.description: Calculate Vimshottari Dasha and identify when significators activate

step_6.name: Cross-Check with Ruling Planets
step_6.description: At time of prediction, verify with 5 ruling planets

birth_chart_analysis.result: Combination of favorable sub-lord + significator activation via dasha + ruling planet confirmation = event certainty

horary_principles.name: KP Horary Astrology
horary_principles.description: KP excels in horary (prashna) questions due to sub-lord precision
horary_principles.principle_1: Question time's Lagna cusp is the main significator for the querist
horary_principles.principle_2: Different houses represent different types of questions
horary_principles.principle_3: Ruling planets at question time strongly confirm or deny the event
horary_principles.principle_4: Sub-lord of relevant cusp gives final yes/no answer
horary_principles.accuracy: KP horary is highly precise when sub-lord analysis is applied correctly
horary_principles.example: For 'Will I marry this year?': Check 7th house cusp sub-lord. If it significates 2,7,11, answer is YES. If it significates 1,6,10,12, answer is NO.

differences.kp: Highly precise, specifically designed for horary

constellation_lords.name: Constellation (Nakshatra) Lords
constellation_lords.description: In KP, the nakshatra lord is given importance second only to the sub-lord
constellation_lords.role: Determines the primary significations of a planet

bhava_analysis.name: Bhava (House) Analysis
bhava_analysis.description: Each bhava (house) spans from one cusp to the next, not entire signs
bhava_analysis.advantage: More precise definition of house boundaries and significations

transits_in_kp.name: Transit Analysis
transits_in_kp.description: Transits are used to trigger dasha significators, not independently
transits_in_kp.principle: Transit of a significator to favorable positions confirms the dasha results

divisional_charts.name: Divisional Charts (Vargas)
divisional_charts.description: D9 (Navamsha) and other divisions are used in KP to confirm birth chart significators
divisional_charts.method: Check if divisional sub-lords also signify supportive houses

combustion.name: Combustion (Sun Proximity)
combustion.description: In KP, combustion does not deny results; it delays them or modifies expression
combustion.principle: Combusted planet can still act as significator if sub-lord is favorable

remedial_measures.name: Remedies in KP Context
remedial_measures.philosophy: KP focuses on understanding the inexorable results of karma. Remedies work by shifting consciousness and attracting beneficial transits.

methods.name: Gem Stones
methods.rationale: Wear gems for strong significators to enhance their positive expression

methods.name: Fasting
methods.rationale: Fast on day of weak significator to reduce adverse effects

methods.name: Mantra Recitation
methods.rationale: Recite mantras of strong beneficial significators

methods.name: Charity
methods.rationale: Give to those ruled by malefic significators to mitigate their negative effects

methods.name: Timing
methods.rationale: KP's greatest strength: use sub-lord analysis to time actions perfectly

remedial_measures.timing_as_remedy: The best remedy in KP is to understand when an event WILL occur (through sub-lord analysis) and prepare accordingly

error_1.name: Ignoring House Cups
error_1.problem: Treating houses as entire signs instead of cuspal divisions
error_1.solution: Always identify exact cusp degrees and their sub-lords

error_2.name: Over-relying on Aspects
error_2.problem: Using traditional aspect rules without sub-lord confirmation
error_2.solution: Sub-lord is the final arbiter; aspects are secondary

error_3.name: Misunderstanding Retrograde
error_3.problem: Thinking retrograde planets are weak or denied
error_3.solution: Retrograde = redirected, not denied; still acts as significator

error_4.name: Neglecting Ruling Planets
error_4.problem: Not checking ruling planets at judgment time
error_4.solution: Always verify with 5 ruling planets for confirmation

error_5.name: Wrong House System
error_5.problem: Using whole sign or equal house instead of Placidus
error_5.solution: KP mandates Placidus house system exclusively

error_6.name: Ignoring Dasha Timing
error_6.problem: Predicting event without dasha activation of significators
error_6.solution: Event only manifests when dasha-significator alignment occurs

glossary.significator: A planet that represents the queried matter through house significations
glossary.sub_lord: The planet owning the nakshatra-sub division where a cusp degree falls
glossary.cusp: The exact degree marking the boundary of a house
glossary.placidus_system: House division system using semi-arcs, mandatory for KP
glossary.vimshottari_dasha: 120-year planetary period cycle used for timing events
glossary.ruling_planets: 5 factors determined at query time that confirm predictions
glossary.horary: Astrology of questions; using query chart to answer specific questions
glossary.bhava: House in Sanskrit; the 12 divisions of the chart
glossary.karaka: Significator planet for a house or matter
